query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gcms_peaks (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  chromatogram_id INT NOT NULL,
  retention_time DECIMAL(6,3) NOT NULL,
  peak_area DECIMAL(12,2),
  peak_height DECIMAL(12,2),
  compound_name VARCHAR(255),
  cas_number VARCHAR(50),
  match_quality INT,
  concentration_ppm DECIMAL(10,4),
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (chromatogram_id) REFERENCES gcms_chromatograms(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
